description: The executed evidence gate (make sql-execution-gate) runs every TPC-DS query on DataFusion 54 at SF0.01 and compares rows with DuckDB and the TPC reference row counts. On fork wheel 30.24.0.6 DataFusion returns 4 rows for Q21 where DuckDB and the TPC reference return 6, and different ratio values for Q78 (2.0 vs 2.32) and Q83 (0.0/0.0 vs 10.0/2.5/20.83): integer / integer truncates. The SQLite equivalent was fixed in 30.24.0.5/6. Fix in the fork (exact division for the DataFusion generator, opt-in or default per the SQLite precedent), adopt the wheel, and remove the three DataFusion entries from scripts/sql_execution_gate/expected_differences.json. Published-result impact: any published DataFusion TPC-DS run that includes Q21, Q78 or Q83 holds wrong rows for those queries.
